turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I just started a new job across town and I'm choosing how to get there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Listen to all of them first, then comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first option is the express bus, about thirty five minutes, but it's often packed.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's the train, which is faster, but I'd have to walk fifteen minutes to the station.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is a tram that's slower but stops right outside my building.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is biking to the train station and taking the train from there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the full list. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Biking to the station and taking the train is probably the fastest and adds some exercise. The tram is the most relaxed choice since it's door to door. The express bus is fine, but crowding every day can wear you down.
